name: Canva
description: A visual design platform for presentations, graphics, documents and more.
longDescription: Canva provides browser-based design tools and templates for individuals and teams. Features and plan availability may change.
limitations: Some assets and features require paid access
Brand and licensing terms should be reviewed

articleContent.introduction: Canva is a visual communication and design platform.
articleContent.overview: It combines templates and editing tools for common design tasks.
articleContent.howItWorks: Choose a format or template, customize the design and export or share it using supported options.
articleContent.evaluation: Check licensing, export requirements and paid asset restrictions for your intended use.

faqs.a: Canva offers a free tier; current limits and paid features are listed on its official site.
